events.body:
## Context

README says the manual-run curl makes "an immediate monitor run", but `worker.py` defaults to `shard=0` and skips other shards, so only about a quarter of monitors run. `?shard=0..3`, `/api/test-slack`, `/api/histories` and `POST /api/history/<id>` are undocumented.

## What to do

1. Document `?shard=N` with a loop example and add a short API table with auth requirements.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every route in `Default.fetch` is listed with its auth

## How to test locally

```bash
Docs only.
```
